1. you were only two years older, but you always knelt down on the mat to untie my wet laces. 2. you picked at the tight double knots with cold fingers, and never once told me to hurry up. 3. so i spent years thinking wet shoes were just something someone knelt down to solve. 4. but yesterday you fell asleep on the sofa at seven in the evening, after twelve hours on your feet. 5. you didn't even make it out of your heavy work coat before your head dropped. 6. so i knelt on the rug, loosened the stiff laces, and eased both boots off by the heel. 7. i set them straight against the wall, because it was finally my turn to bend down.
✍️ Caption
we grew up sharing a bedroom floor and hand-me-down coats. it takes twenty years to notice when the person who looked after you gets tired. send this to the cousin who always untied your knots first. #growinguptogether #childhoodmemories #childhoodfriends #nostalgia
